text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the dawn of the new year—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...There are quite a lot of people here 
after all.
choice_data_list:
There are quite a few girls who look like 
academy students. Look over there—

There are quite a few girls who look like 
academy students here. Look—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm? You came as well, Alv? Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-san... Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much... for all your help 
last year.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't done anything special. It was 
all your own strength."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Regarding your talent, my mother has 
always—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Do you two have plans after this?
choice_data_list: No, we're both off today.
No, we're both off today, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see. In that case, I'd like you to keep 
me company for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Where do you plan on going?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—It's the New Year's gathering at my 
family's home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A New Year's party at Air Groove's family 
home. —That meant finally meeting her 
mother face-to-face.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! So glad you could make it. 
Please, make yourselves right at home!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: That person—no, that lady...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Air Groove's mother. A legendary 
Umamusume known to anyone involved in 
racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She conquered the Oaks during her racing 
career. And after retiring with honor, she 
opened a school to train a select elite of 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her daughter, Air Groove, is naturally an 
alumna of that school too. Truly... she is 
a great mother in the Umamusume world...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Your hands are trembling, you know.
choice_data_list: T-That's true, yeah...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you're looking nervous as a cat in a 
strange room. You can relax a bit more, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Admire Groove-chan? It's Alve-chan, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! I hear about you all the time 
from Air Groove. Come on over!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll be right back... for a moment.
choice_data_list: That Alv is actually being so obedient...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh, Mother is a battle-hardened veteran, 
after all. Her dignified presence is 
conveyed naturally.

text_block_list.name: School Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer-san, come over here and 
chat!
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
All the staff members here are Umamusume 
who received direct guidance from my 
mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
These oral traditions go beyond mere 
technical theory; you, too, will surely 
learn much from them.

text_block_list.name: School Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Toward the end of training, it's hard to 
keep your focus, right? The way to let 
them rest at times like that is...

text_block_list.name: School Staff B
text_block_list.text:
No, no, taking care of your knee joints 
and ankles is way more important, right? 
Let me show you my secret fatigue relief—
choice_data_list:
A flood of passionately crafted training 
theories is rushing in...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
To master that form purely through 
self-study... you've got some real talent, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"It's been a while since I felt my heart 
ache like this. If you'd like, why don't 
we—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mother... please keep your mischief in 
moderation. Even Alv looks quite 
bewildered.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so sorry~! I just couldn't resist 
teaching you in person. Ah, but Alv-chan—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Working out your body is important, but 
from now on, don't just think about 
"growth"—think about "maintenance" too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Maintain... our current pace?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, your body has been growing rapidly so 
far, but starting in the Senior Class, 
things will change a bit.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Transitioning from the growth phase into 
maturity. That means required nutrition 
changes too, so ingenuity suited to the 
shift will be vital.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
And take your rest properly, too—go all 
out and take a proper break! Especially 
for someone as stoic as you!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I see... So that's how it works.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yep! A strong body and a durable body 
might sound similar, but they're two 
totally different things, you know?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —I've learned a lot.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I... might have been a little 
mistaken.
choice_data_list: A misunderstanding...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Interacting with others is a waste of 
time. Because—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I thought it would just be people licking 
each other's wounds. But the people here 
are different...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
We face running together, exchanging 
information, and pushing each other to 
greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
So interactions like this... exist too, 
huh.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, you're right.
...Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A welcome change... it seems. Admire 
Groove appears to have reconsidered her 
overly stubborn attitude...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if that's the case... Alv, there's 
someone I want you to meet.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"That person" said they really wanted to 
speak with you. —This way.
—Yes.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...My name is Duramente. It is... a 
pleasure to meet you."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —!? Dura... mente...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(This... feeling... This... atmosphere 
is...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(She's probably... strong. There's still a 
childishness to her, but her presence is 
completely different. And...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(My chest... is stirred... Is it wariness 
of the strong? ...Is that really all it 
is?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(This... feeling welling up inside me... 
Why is my spine shivering...?)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You might have seen her around the academy 
at least. She's also an alumna of my 
mother's "School."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Among my pupils, she is an exceptionally 
promising star."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I watched all of last year's races.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"And so... if there was ever an 
opportunity, I wanted to talk with you."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Something seemed different between 
before the 'Shuka Sho' and after."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Her run in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup... I 
remember it vividly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Could I ask you... a few things? Please, 
tell me the secret to becoming stronger.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes... However...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...Oh dear. I'm not used to this, and 
besides... I still can't settle down.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
... ...Trainer. I'll leave the rest to 
you.
choice_data_list: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly put on the spot, I scramble to 
think of an answer. The secret to getting 
stronger is—
choice_data_list: Not pushing myself too hard... I guess?

I think it's about not creating any 
weaknesses.
Expanding your repertoire.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
However, I had heard that you were doing 
quite intense training, Senpai...
choice_data_list:
I'll make sure you don't overwork 
yourself, though.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "...I see. Next, thenâ"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(What a whirlwind of a day... Going to bed 
early would be the smart move...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...However...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Duramente-san... That "feeling" I got 
when talking to her up close...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder what that was... I've never 
experienced anything like it...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Train everything in a well-balanced 
manner... got it.
choice_data_list: It depends on the path we aim for, but...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see... I will likely be required to have 
such aptitudes as well...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: That's very helpful reference.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After parting ways with Air Groove at her 
family home, night had fallen by the time 
we returned to the academy.
choice_data_list: She seemed like an honest junior.
She seemed like a really honest junior.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'm not really used to that sort of 
thing. However...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Duramente-san... That "feeling" I got 
when talking to her up close...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder what that was... I've never 
experienced anything like it...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. Tactics cannot be neglected 
after all."
choice_data_list:
The flow of the race is constantly 
shifting, after all.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
To aim for the strongest... physical 
strength alone is not enough, is it? I 
shall keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the car heading back to the academy 
after parting with Air Groove at her 
family's home—
choice_data_list:
How should I put it... She was quite a 
straightforward girl.

How should I put it... She was quite a 
straightforward girl.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Duramente-san... That "feeling" I got 
when talking to her up close...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder what that was... I've never 
experienced anything like it...)
